reviews.title: Impressive and enjoyable exercise for improving focus
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.This book has really helped improve my focus which has been slipping over the past few years. Too much screen time and not enough focused thinking I suspect.The puzzle itself isn’t difficult but it does take care, focus, and persistence to get to the answer. Occasionally I’ve been sure I’ve got the easier clues out of the way on a page, only to discover something I’ve missed while working on other clues. I’ve actually really enjoyed these moments as it’s made me focus even more.This has been an absolute joy to do on my commute and, like many others have commented before me, I really recommend coloured pens and highlighters to accompany your puzzling! 🤗The book’s paper is very good quality and I’ve not had any issue with highlighter ink going through to reverse of page.Last thing to note which has really taken me by surprise… the focus has continued long after I’ve stopped working on the book and I’ve noted a demonstrable difference in my work output too.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: I found them
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Kept seeing this book online and decided to try it. My first ever elimination puzzle book and I really enjoyed it. So much so I ordered another 2 but slightly different.My tips would be to get good pens. Pastel colours or highlighters that allow you still read the names and also don't bleed through the page. Read the clues properly. Make sure you fully understand them. You might be able to do 2 clues at the same time. Just because you have highlighted a name, it doesn't mean you wont need it later. It may also be realavent to more than 1 clue. Don't be too quick to eliminate pages. They're still helpful.Clues are explained in more detail online. Once you think you have the name you submit it online. You get a response within the hour. You can complete this quickly if you use the clues properly but it's not all about speed if you want your moneys worth do them all. Enjoy but be warned you will buy moreRead moreRead less

reviews.title: Great fun!
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.I really enjoyed doing this puzzle. I knew it was going to be a lot of trawling through pages checking the clues and I was ready for that level of focus and paying attention.What surprised me were the little Easter eggs scattered throughout the pages ... famous names and characters strategically placed together. A great touch!I'm annoyed that I didn't solve it on the first pass and was then surprised on the second pass just how many bits and pieces I'd missed. I'd read all the clues first and applied them strategically, but its still easy to miss a name here and there!Thoroughly enjoyed it for novelty and would like to do one or two more but I'm not sure others could live up to the quality or value of this one.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: The best puzzle & murder mystery going!
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.If you love logic puzzles & murder mystery I can highly recommend this book - The Killer isn't Alice by Iris Starling.I've spent the last 2 & ½ weeks figuring it out. It's brilliant because there really is only one name that fits all the clues. However your interpretation of the clues along the way will affect your progress.My advice is to use coloured pencils you can rub out! If you get to a point where you have multiple pages & names left then your interpretation of the clues is off. Happened to me however it actually added to my enjoyment of the book.The solution isn't in the book so you cannot cheat. You go onto the official website & fill in the solutions box to receive an email that will tell you if you're right or not. There are some tips & clarifications of the clues on there as well.Brilliant. Loved it.Read moreRead less
